commands.effect: Return the compact Authoring knowledge frame index.
Return one generated versioned contract projection.

commands.prerequisite: valid request and a non-existing contained output root
commands.effect: Create a persistent Run at initialized.
Verify and report current state without changing it.
Observe current renderer activity without verifying or changing durable state. A null activity is not evidence of completion or failure. Use run.status for authoritative state.

commands.prerequisite: an existing Run and a request-bound authorization signed by the trusted Studio
commands.effect: Record a signed Studio authorization on the same Run. Null limits and expiry mean unlimited production; historical finite decisions remain readable. Preserve all consumption, image jobs, artifacts and prior decisions. An agent cannot sign an authorization or accept media by changing it.

commands.prerequisite: no Take has been recorded or reused
commands.effect: Terminate at declined while preserving any draft plan.

commands.prerequisite: a non-terminal Run and readable plan
commands.effect: Validate without mutating the plan and bind a green immutable snapshot.
Publish plan-only checks and advisory duration assessment.

commands.prerequisite: fresh validation and Preflight; grant only for an identical-input replacement
commands.effect: Reuse a verified Take or perform one authorised synthesis dispatch.

commands.prerequisite: fresh validation and Preflight plus a verified matching Take
commands.effect: Compile authoritatively without network or quota.

commands.prerequisite: a fresh green compilation and Compiled document
commands.effect: Render the bound document without network or quota.

commands.prerequisite: a compiled ASSET_PLACEHOLDER work item; grant when the image provider is live
commands.effect: Create or observe an identity-bound image job. After explicit rejection, a different request with a fresh exact grant may create a correction. Studio authorization or a separate operator recovery policy permits retryOf naming the latest confirmed temporary HTTP failure (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) with the unchanged exact provider request; the predecessor, new grant and consumed attempt remain durable. Repeating retryOf observes that retry rather than dispatching again. run.status publishes the authorized image-attempt ceiling and nextImageDispatchAt; wait before a new dispatch. Uncertain work never permits retry. Without Studio authorization or a recovery policy, failed jobs remain blocked. Operator envelopes issue exact grants internally; all jobs remain counted; a null Studio image ceiling is unlimited.

commands.prerequisite: an image job belonging to the Run
commands.effect: Observe the existing image job without starting or retrying generation.

commands.prerequisite: a candidate and a decision naming its exact digest
commands.effect: Promote the candidate for this Run and stale compilations that used a placeholder.

commands.prerequisite: an inspectable candidate, or an accepted image with candidateSha256 and reason
commands.effect: Reject a pending candidate or withdraw exact accepted bytes with a reason. Preserve jobs, grants and quota; stale compilation and render bindings. Recompile before correcting the requirement.

durationSeconds.description: Estimated target duration in seconds, not authored scene timing or a word quota.

maxGeneratedImages.description: Maximum new image generation jobs in this Run, including failed attempts; reuse is free. This is not a required image or scene count.
